entities.summary: Rubén Manuel Espinosa Becerril was a Mexican self-taught photographer and journalist. He worked for AVC News agency and Proceso and Cuartoscuro magazines. He covered daily news and social protests. He documented several protests where individuals were assaulted. Espinosa was killed in Narvarte, Mexico City, Mexico along with four women.
